purpose: Record local source-context review for all 24 C2-LT-B7 source extraction rows. This register verifies structural readiness for independent fresh review while preserving FDA route failures, dynamic donor-registration route context, duplicate CDC source lineage, screening-boundary downgrade constraints, reviewed-artifact blocks and model-admission blocks.

scope.selectionRule: Review all C2-LT-B7 source extraction rows after field-level extraction, without promoting any row to reviewed artifact fill or calibrated model admission.
currentLimitations: This is local structural review only and is not independent fresh review.
Rows with FDA 404 routes, dynamic registration route context or duplicate CDC source lineage require source-resolution/manual route handling before bounded artifact use.
USPSTF ovarian and prostate screening rows preserve screening nonbenefit and shared-decision boundaries as downgrade constraints, not as individual screening advice.
Oncology, transplant, organ-donation and xenotransplantation rows remain bounded source-context rows until independent fresh review.
No row admits calibrated prediction, intervention ranking, individual advice, clinical-validity claim, individual death-date output or domain-claim upgrade.

localReviewChecks: Every reviewed task is present in the C2-LT-B7 source extraction queue.
Every reviewed task has a completed extraction row in the C2-LT-B7 source extraction register.
Every extraction row preserves exact claim use, endpoint, population or setting, mechanism or effect, uncertainty, transfer boundary, downgrade triggers and model position.
Every extraction row keeps model admission blocked and prohibited uses complete.
Every local domain path exists and exposes README.md and AGENTS.md.
Rows with FDA route failures, dynamic donor-registration route context or duplicate CDC source lineage are explicitly preserved in sourceResolutionFindings.
Screening nonbenefit and shared-decision rows keep downgrade boundaries but are not converted into individual screening advice.
The register routes non-issue rows to independent fresh review and issue rows to source-resolution/manual-route review before Source Card promotion.

sourceResolutionFindings.correctionCandidate: Treat EXT-019 as the transplant-safety primary CDC guidance route and link EXT-022 as duplicate/role-specific provenance instead of independent evidence.
sourceResolutionFindings.reason: The same CDC transplant-safety guidance route is reused across transplant safety and organ-donation governance rows; local review must block double counting.

sourceResolutionFindings.reason: The extraction row records a local HTTP 404; it can only remain route metadata until a valid FDA source is verified.

sourceResolutionFindings.correctionCandidate: Link EXT-022 to EXT-019 and preserve it as organ-donation governance context, not as a second independent transplant-safety evidence count.
sourceResolutionFindings.reason: The extraction row explicitly marks duplicate CDC source lineage; fresh review must prevent duplicate support inflation.

sourceResolutionFindings.reason: The extraction row records a local HTTP 404; it cannot support xenotransplantation safety, feasibility or clinical claims until the active document route is verified.

sourceResolutionFindings.reason: The extraction row is route metadata with local HTTP 404; it cannot support a substantive xenotransplantation claim until route resolution succeeds.

nonClaims: This register is not an independent fresh review verdict register.
This register does not complete any reviewed Source Card, variable card, endpoint card, uncertainty card, transfer-boundary card or downgrade-check artifact.
This register does not repair FDA 404 routes, dynamic donor-registration route context or duplicate CDC source lineage; it records them for source-resolution review.
This register does not validate external source truth, clinical recommendations, screening decisions, intervention effects, calibrated risks or individual prognosis.
This register does not authorize model admission, domain-claim upgrade, intervention ranking, individual advice or individual death-date output.
